# Prism

> Prism is a desktop app that turns long videos into vertical Shorts with captions. AI finds moments that stand on their own; you review them and make the final cut. Captions are written in the language spoken in the video. Prism is in beta; AI usage limits apply.

- Who it's for: creators, podcasters and streamers who want short-form clips from long recordings.
- Platforms: macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon; Windows and Linux ports have not yet been tested on real devices.
- Access: On Mac, sign in to try the beta; AI usage limits apply. Windows and Linux use your own Gemini API key. Paid plans are not available yet.
- Status: beta. Review every Short before publishing.

- [FAQ](https://prismclips.vercel.app/faq): Answers about plans, privacy, editing and getting started.
